snippet.title: On Together Reveal Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2025
snippet.description: On-Together is a cozy multiplayer productivity game that lives at the bottom of your screen-- meet with your friends for focused work and study sessions or make the most out of your breaks with fun activities and mini games. Shoot hoops, chill at the café, or join a spontaneous fishing tournament between tasks - it's the perfect wind down (and task manager!) for long days at your desk. http://s.team/a/3707400 #WholesomeDirect #SummerGameFest #IndieGames
